svg.title: goPool benchmark heat map
svg.desc: Heat map of mining.submit and mining.notify benchmark results from the August 13, 2026 rerun. Each numeric metric column is colored independently; failed cells are labeled explicitly.
svg.text: Rerun August 13, 2026. Green is better; red is worse.
* WarpPool's stock Enterprise profile has a 4,096-connection hard cap.
No-ZMQ colors use a logarithmic scale so the ckpool outlier does not flatten the panel.
